_about: Copy this file to research/monthly-recap/config.json (gitignored) and replace every <...> value. backend/monthly_recap.py refuses to run until it is filled in. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
county: <Your county, as the slides should name it>
_county_extent: Two opposite corners of a box around your county, [lat, lng] each. Used to frame the overview map and to flag incidents outside the county as possible mutual aid.
_in_county_agencies: Agency names exactly as your event names start with them (the first word or words). An event name starting with one of these is treated as in-county; anything else is flagged for you to confirm.
_d4h_env: The deploy.env ENV_NAME whose gcloud configuration reads production D4H and CalTopo.
_deck_folder: Where the presenter keeps the monthly decks, as they would say it (for example a shared-drive path). Render prints it in the next-step message; the script never writes there.
